# ToolRoute — The OpenRouter for Tools

One API key. Every tool. Unified API gateway for 50+ AI agent tools.

## API

POST https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/execute — Execute any tool
GET  https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/tools  — Browse available tools with pricing

## Authentication

All /execute requests require a Bearer API key (tr_live_xxx).
Obtain one at https://toolroute.ai/dashboard/keys

## Quick Start

```bash
curl -X POST https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/execute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"toolroute/check_before_build","input":{"task":"I need to send emails"}}'
```

## Response Format

```json
{
  "id": "req_abc123",
  "tool": "toolroute/check_before_build",
  "provider": "toolroute",
  "data": { ... },
  "usage": { "cost": 0.0, "balance_remaining": 10.0, "latency_ms": 120 }
}
```
